b1.deptHint: Up to 6 levels; non-empty departments cannot be deleted.

b1.delegateHint: Inquiries go to the delegate during leave

b2.hsNote: HS code suggestions (for reference; confirm with your customs broker)
b2.question: Objection
b2.boundaryHint: 'Cannot say' and forbidden words are enforced by content QA (blocking); human topics are flagged for manual handling. One per line.
b2.docHint: PDF / Word / PPT / Excel / CSV / TXT, ≤100MB each, ≤50 per upload. Images need OCR (not enabled). Parsed items go to KB as pending.
b2.gradeHint: A/B: total deal amount and deal count thresholds; C: valid follow-up in last N days; else D. Recomputed daily.
b2.label: Label
b2.accImportHint: Upload CSV / Excel; common columns are auto-mapped. Same name with a different domain is flagged as a suspected duplicate.
b2.merge: Merge accounts (requires approval without CRM admin)

b3.abHint: A/B variants are assigned per enrollment; a winner needs ≥50 sends per variant
b3.enrollRes: Enrolled {{enrolled}}, blocked {{blocked}}, excluded {{excluded}}, already in sequence {{duplicate}}
b3.expiredHint: Report is older than 30 days; refresh before use
b3.gradeExplain: All conditions in a grade must be met; empty = no limit. Others fall into D.
b3.mergeConfirm: Contacts, opportunities and quotes will move to the master account; can be split later. Merge?
b3.name: Name
b3.savedHint: Subscribed searches run daily; new companies are pushed as an in-app discovery digest
b3.semanticPh: Describe in one sentence, e.g. German heat pump distributors
b3.subject: Subject
b3.title: Title

b4.aiHelp: Answers only from confirmed KB / objections / active products; sensitive or out-of-scope questions go to a human
b4.askPh: e.g. How do I set up SPF?
b4.budgetInfo: Budgets count credits spent per calendar month; hard limits block credit-consuming actions.
b4.budgetLevels: Five levels: tenant / department / member here; sequence budget in sequence settings (AI writing 0.1 credit/email); task budget in agent tasks.
b4.chatNote: Replies appear only in the visitor's chat window; no email or external message is sent.
b4.closureDesc: A 30-day grace period follows (you can withdraw); then all company data is deleted and a deletion certificate issued. Export your data first.
b4.closurePending: Termination requested; data will be purged on {{d}}
b4.closureWarn: All customers, contacts, emails, quotes and audit logs will be permanently deleted.
b4.consentHelp: Leave empty for the default English consent text
b4.legalNote: Templates are filled with your company info; have counsel review before use.
b4.mockPayNote: Mock payment channel (no real provider connected). Confirming only marks the bill paid here; no money moves.
b4.name: Name
b4.noExternal: Widgets talk only to this system; submissions go to the inbox/inquiries and never trigger outbound email.
b4.originsHelp: Comma-separated domains; empty allows any site (not recommended)
b4.planNote: Plans are set by the platform admin; upgrades apply now, downgrades next period. Unused included credits roll over one month.
b4.slaInfo: SLA: P1 1h first response / 8h resolve; P2 4/24; P3 8/72; P4 24/168 hours.
b4.subject: Subject
b4.widgetIntro: Embed inquiry forms and live chat on your website. Submissions create contacts (with consent), inbox conversations, scored inquiries and delivery packages.

b5.askPh: Ask your data, e.g. reply rate by country in the last 90 days
b5.askNote: Only whitelisted metrics and dimensions; AI never writes database queries. Sales reps see only their own data.
b5.name: Name
b5.learnLine: {{sent}} emails sent recently, overall reply rate {{rate}}%
b5.noSugg: No suggestion meets the sample threshold yet
b5.schNote: Scheduled/event triggers only create tasks: plan, credit estimate and approval gates are the same as manual tasks; nothing is sent automatically. Each trigger has a daily cap.
b5.taskCreated: Task created; confirm its plan in Agent tasks
b5.styleEmpty: Not enough samples ({{n}} now; need at least 3 manual replies or approved drafts)
b5.styleNote: Only statistical features are stored, never the text. Used by AI and rule-based writing. You can turn it off.
b5.rollbackQ: Roll back to v{{v}}? A new version will be created
b5.kbNote: Each AI draft records the knowledge version and prompt version used.
b5.qaPh: e.g. What are their main products?
b5.title: Title
b5.pickAccount: Pick an account (required to create a draft quote)
b5.injWarn: The attachment contains suspected prompt-injection text; it was treated as plain data. Please review.
b5.unmatched: Lines not matched to the product library
b5.noEvals: No eval runs yet (run by platform admin or CI)
b5.evalNote: Evals must pass before a new prompt or model is released (CI runs python -m app.admin eval).
